text:
cam: quick flag from usability testing: when you open the invite drawer and type an email, then switch the SSO toggle, the inline helper collapses and the focus jumps to the audit log link. reproducible in Chrome+VO.
rachel: repro steps?
cam: org settings -> members -> invite -> type email -> toggle 'Require SSO' -> press tab. focus lands on the breadcrumb audit link.
omar: likely because the helper area is re-rendered and an element in the breadcrumb gets focus on update. we should avoid programmatic focus on non-modal updates.
access-bot: accessibility hint: prefer aria-live="polite" for helper copy and keep focus inside drawer until close. also ensure removed/changed controls are removed from tab order immediately.
cam: copy suggestion for helper: "Require SSO for new users. This prevents signups outside your identity provider. Learn more." short version for compact: "Require SSO for new users."
rachel: design ask: add a small visible hint in the drawer header "Esc to close" and ensure focus-trap re-evaluates after DOM patches (focusTrap.update()). also use prefers-reduced-motion for chip transitions.
omar: agree. implementation plan: 1) remove autofocus on breadcrumb updates, 2) add aria-describedby from toggle to helper, 3) set tabindex=-1 on removed chips before DOM removal, 4) run keyboard e2e.
cam: assigning: omar for the JS patch, rachel for copy + tiny visual, access-bot will run regression. target for next patch release.
access-bot: created issue INV-4970: invite drawer focus loss on SSO toggle.
